## Change summary

Describe the observable behavior changed and link the source story IDs.

## Evidence

- [ ] Relevant design decision recorded in `docs/design-decisions.md`.
- [ ] Documentation and contracts updated.
- [ ] Focused tests run and results reported.
- [ ] Full validation run where practical.
- [ ] Known gaps are stated; no native-reader, accessibility, licence, or benchmark claim is made without evidence.

## Safety and governance

- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or customer documents are included.
- [ ] Dependency, font, model, and container licence impact was checked.
- [ ] Untrusted document processing remains isolated and network-disabled.
